(Nasdaq: RAPP) (“Rapport” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage biotechnology company dedicated to the discovery and development of small molecule precision medicines for patients with neurological and psychiatric disorders, today announced positive topline results from its Phase 2 trial of RAP-219 in adults with acute bipolar mania.
Topline efficacy and safety data reported are from the three-week treatment period.
• RAP-641: Phase 1 preliminary results are expected in the second half of 2027.

• Financial position: As of June 30, 2026, Rapport had $436.1 million in cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments, excluding restricted cash, expected to fund operations into the second half of 2029, beyond expected topline data from the Company’s Phase 3 program in focal onset seizures. [ * Safety and tolerability data as of interim database lock, September 16, 2026.] Conference Call Information Rapport Therapeutics will host a conference call and live webcast at 8:00 a.m.
